bio: Educación financiera rápida, dibujada y al grano. Aprende a dominar tu dinero, salir de deudas e invertir en menos de 2 minutos. 💸🧠
target_audience: Jóvenes adultos (18-35) buscando mejorar sus finanzas personales, salir de deudas y aprender a invertir sin terminología aburrida o compleja.

visual_identity.style: Dynamic hand-drawn 2D webcomic sketch style, minimalist, expressive black ink on white background with vibrant accents (green/gold).

logo_prompt: A minimalist, hand-drawn 2D sketch style logo for a personal finance channel. A stylized brain with a glowing coin inside, drawn with thick expressive black ink outlines on a clean white background. Subtle vibrant green highlights. Clean shading, modern webcomic aesthetic, highly recognizable as a profile picture.
banner_prompt: A dynamic, hand-drawn 2D webcomic sketch style banner for a YouTube channel about personal finance. Thick expressive black ink outlines on a clean white background. The scene shows a visual progression from left to right: starting with a broken piggy bank, moving to a growing money tree in the center, and ending with a rising financial chart on the right. Vibrant minimalist color palette with green and gold highlights. Clean shading, glowing accents, wide horizontal panoramic layout.

outro_prompt.description: Animated logo outro for a personal finance YouTube/TikTok channel, hand-drawn 2D webcomic sketch style. The scene starts black. A coin drops from the top center with a satisfying 'clink' motion, bouncing once. As it settles, thick expressive black ink lines rapidly sketch the channel logo (a brain with a coin inside) around the coin, as if being drawn live. The logo pulses once with a vibrant green glow. The channel name 'CHANNEL_NAME' materializes below in bold geometric font, letter by letter, in gold. A subtle paper texture background fades in. The outro ends with the logo centered, glowing softly. Clean, energetic, 3-second loop-friendly. Black background. No voiceover.
